explication: n8n-MCP is an MCP server that gives AI assistants structured access to n8n node knowledge and tools for managing workflows. The main path is an assistant making MCP requests, tool dispatch into discovery, validation, or management handlers, and—where requested—calls to an n8n instance. The repository also documents templates, community-node discovery, and UI results as product capabilities. Storage and parsing support the knowledge layer. Several subsystem links are documented rather than verified in sampled implementation; those links are dashed, and unsampled internals are not inferred.
